prompt: Find one Attendance row that looks wrong: present with null check_in and check_out, is_lop with lop_hours 0, or check_out before check_in. Call Attendance.get, then Attendance.update it to status absent (keep the same date and employee_id). Put a short note in the shift field that this is a team13 agent correction (Attendance has no reason field). If you cannot find such a row, refuse with escalate_to explaining what you searched — do not invent a row.
